headline: Public hearing on a 110 Leigus Road apartment complex, plus new wetlands applications and violation updates.
summary: The commission will continue a public hearing on an 83-unit apartment complex at 110 Leigus Road. It will also review new applications for South Cherry Street, Hall Avenue, Country Way, and South Colony Road, along with reports and ongoing violation cases.
items: Public Hearing #A26-7.1 / 110 Leigus Road – Metro Realty – Multi-family apartment complex (83 units) with associated parking area under CT Statute 8-30g
#A26-7.2 / 528 South Cherry Street – Virginia Ryan, CPEA, REM – Site clearing and remedial actions for waste
#A26-7.6 / 358 Hall Avenue – Jeffrey Laforge – Proposed Parking Lot Expansion (Tabled at request of the applicant)
#A26-9.1 / 23A Country Way – Daniel Riley – Proposed fence (Acceptance of Applications)
#26-10.1 / 900/902/920/940 So. Colony Road – Dominick DeMartino – Mixed use development (Acceptance of Applications)
#26-10.2 / 1052 South Colony Road – Dominick DeMartino – added 10/6/26 (Acceptance of Applications)
Bond Release Request for 59 North Elm Street Carr Hall (IWWC #A22-10.1)
Communications from 2 Wheatfield Drive dated 9/24/26, 9/29/26 and Environmental Planner dated 9/15/26 and 10/1/2026 on 360 Woodhouse Ave
Request for permit transfer for Permit #A24-10.2, 231 New Chesire Road

Cease & Desist Order Remains – 250 Cook Hill Road – unpermitted alteration of wetlands, installation of structures in or near wetlands, deposition of significant amount of fill material in Upland Review Area – issued 4/14/26; Order affirmed 4/22/26; Staff Memo Update on Violation 10/1/26
988 East Center Street – filling of wetlands – #A19-3.6 – Staff Memo recommendation for closing of violation and release of bond

Notice of Violation Remains – 1245 Old Colony Road & Quinnipiac River – Jerzy Pytel – unpermitted clearing & filling near river – issued 6/4/19; NOV to be recorded on Land Records per 10/4/23 action; NOV affirmed 12/3/25

Notice of Violation Remains – 24 Mapleview Road – Patricia Clarke c/o James W. & Patricia Clarke, Trustee of The Clarke 2022 Living Trust – alteration & filling within wetlands and in Upland Review Area on 24 Mapleview Rd. & on 13 Rolling Meadow Dr. – issued 4/21/23; NOV affirmed 12/3/25
location: Robert F. Parisi Council Chambers, Second Floor, Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, CT
